questions.prompt: Which conveyor category moves loose grains or powder?
questions.explanation: Bulk conveyors handle loose material; package conveyors move individual items such as boxes.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.
reviewCue.excerpt: Bulk Material Conveyors – move loose materials (powder, grains, pellets). Part / Package Conveyors – transport discrete items (boxes, parts). 3
